manifest.file_rule: files lists exactly every used stage2/adjudication CSV with canonical root-relative path, lowercase SHA-256, and data-row count; all are recomputed

participant_index.cardinality: 24 unique auditors (6/arm), 3 unique gold, 2 unique adjudicators; identity/role/arm/file must match content

adjudicator_packet_registry.manifest_binding: manifest.adjudicator_packet_registry must bind the exact path, file SHA-256, and canonical registry_sha256 root
adjudicator_packet_registry.validation: Rebuild both issued blank packets row by row and bind named role/participant, deterministic adjudication_id, claim_id, ordered disputed_outputs, blinded gold IDs, raw-material hash, registry row/root, and blank-packet SHA-256. Missing, invented-schema, incomplete, or detached registries fail closed.

frozen_cohort.design: 480 unique claims, 80 sources, 6/source; only c2_decisive and c5_decisive, exactly 240 each

input_validation.adjudication: Both completed files retain the exact adjudicator-packet-v1 header; globally unique deterministic adjudication_id; canonical registry metadata; nonempty participant/claim/source/status; exact eligible-claim coverage.
input_validation.status_evidence: README prose is not scanned. Only exact top-level manifest status, structured root status-file fields, obvious invalidation filenames, and known legacy root path names are status evidence.
input_validation.deidentification_key: Every public-table entry point and both CLIs require at least 32 bytes.
input_validation.limitation: manifest authenticates package bytes but cannot by itself prove behavioral independence; other_adjudicator_response_seen is not asserted as verified

analysis_agreement.csv.interpretation: Post hoc descriptive nominal agreement on claims with exactly three completed valid votes. Non-estimable kappa is explicit.

analysis_claim_level.csv: separate gold resolution, strict-majority labels, exact accuracy, and no-consensus fields for A/B/C/D

row_types.class_distribution: All claim-level arm aggregates, including missing and no_consensus.
row_types.resolved_gold_confusion: Arm aggregate versus resolved gold; denominator is all claims with resolved gold.

analysis_individual_raters.csv.interpretation: Private analysis table. Accuracy denominator includes completed valid individual ratings with resolved gold.
analysis_individual_raters.csv.release_policy: NEVER PUBLIC: contains original participant_id values and must remain directly under the private --output directory.

analysis_missingness_patterns.csv.interpretation: Analysis-ready grouped unresolved-gold and arm-missingness rows.

analysis_rater_sensitivity.csv.interpretation: Reviewer-requested post hoc participant summaries, conditional 924-label permutation, two-way clustered individual-rating OLS, and changed-aggregation leave-one-auditor-out rows.
analysis_rater_sensitivity.csv.release_policy: NEVER PUBLIC in this form: leave-one-auditor-out rows contain original participant_id values.

analysis_response_diagnostics.csv.interpretation: Response-status, reason-code, unable/abstention, and row-level UTC elapsed-time diagnostics. Extraction ends at extraction_completed_utc; composition and total end at completed_utc. Timing is not labor cost.

analysis_results.json.adjudicator_sensitivity: separate D-C estimates using each independent adjudicator on disputed claims
analysis_results.json.adjudicator_input_rule: Before any claim map is constructed, each adjudicator file must contain exactly one row per complete-gold disagreement and no other claims; duplicate claim IDs are fatal regardless of adjudication_id, and legal row ordering cannot change results.
analysis_results.json.conditional_equivalence: TOST only when superiority criterion does not pass
analysis_results.json.gold_rule: fewer than three completed experts is unresolved_incomplete_gold with no adjudication; three unanimous experts resolve; three completed disagreements require two agreeing adjudicators
analysis_results.json.inference: source-cluster CR1 with G-1 t reference only when at least two sources and one observation are available; otherwise not_estimable
analysis_results.json.missingness_bounds: Claimwise preregistered D-minus-C bounds: unresolved gold contributes [-1,+1]; with resolved gold, known C/D accuracy is retained and only a missing arm ranges over [0,1]; two known arms contribute their fixed difference.
analysis_results.json.input_authentication_limitation: manifest authenticates package bytes but cannot by itself prove behavioral independence
analysis_results.json.post_hoc_exploratory_rater_sensitivity: Explicitly labeled participant, arm-label permutation, two-way CGM cluster, and leave-one-auditor-out sensitivities.
analysis_results.json.primary: D-C comparability strict-majority exact accuracy; preregistered source-cluster logic unchanged
analysis_results.json.zero_observation_rule: skip CR1, bootstrap, and TOST; retain missingness rates and bounds; conclude inconclusive_nonconfirmatory_missingness

public_release_manifest.json.contents: Schema version, basename, row count, and SHA-256 for an explicit allowlist of files located only in public_release. It includes the three HMAC-deidentified observation tables and safe copies of results, claim-level, gold-resolution, pairwise, agreement, confusion, response-diagnostic, and missingness-pattern outputs. It never inventories the private parent directory.
public_release_manifest.json.release_condition: Written only when --deidentification-key-file names a non-empty key file.

output_layout.private_directory: --output contains the complete analysis, including original-ID participant and rater-sensitivity tables.
output_layout.public_directory: --output/public_release contains only the explicit public allowlist and its manifest.
output_layout.boundary: Files in the private parent directory are not public merely because a public release was requested. analysis_individual_raters.csv, analysis_rater_sensitivity.csv, and every other original-ID table must never be copied to or published from public_release.
